propPlay.writeup:
Jackie Young has cleared 4+ assists in 86% of her 51 games this season, and is riding a 15-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 6.6 assists on the season (7.6 across her last 5) — the 4+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -579 at DraftKings.

Jordin Canada has cleared 9+ points in 79% of her 48 games this season, and is riding a 6-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 11.6 points on the season (17 across her last 5) — the 9+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -590 at Caesars.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -269 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
